user.title: YouTube Music
user.description:
Address of the ytm-pulsar panel on the speaker. The usual port is 24721.

After the wake word:
• turn on youtube — resume the queue
• youtube forward / youtube back
• find on youtube …
• youtube delete everything
• random on youtube

error.cannot_connect: The speaker did not answer. Check the address and that YouTube Music is running.

search.name: Search YouTube
search.description: Find the query on YouTube Music and play it.

random.name: Play random
random.description: Clear the queue and play random YouTube songs.
